title: Getting Started
content:
Follow these simple steps to resize your images:

  1. Click the upload area or drag & drop your image file
  2. Use the crop tool to select the desired area
  3. Enter width and height dimensions
  4. Select unit (pixels, inches, mm, cm)
  5. Choose output format (JPG, PNG, WebP)
  6. Adjust quality slider if needed
  7. Click 'Process Image' and then 'Download Resized Image'

title: Understanding Measurement Units
content:
Pixels (PX)

The basic unit of digital images. Most common for web use.

Inch

Physical measurement. 1 inch at 300 DPI = 300 pixels.

Millimeter (MM)

Metric unit. 25.4mm = 1 inch. Requires DPI conversion.

Centimeter (CM)

Metric unit. 1cm = 10mm. 2.54cm = 1 inch.

title: Output Format Guide
content:
JPG

Best for photographs. Smaller file sizes with quality control.

PNG

Lossless format. Supports transparency. Larger file sizes.

WebP

Modern format. Superior compression. Best for web use.

title: Quality and Compression
content:
Quality Slider

Adjusts output quality (10-100%). Higher quality = larger files.

Target Size

Enter target size in KB. Tool automatically adjusts quality to meet it.

Recommendations

  • Web photos: 60-80% quality
  • Print photos: 85-100% quality
  • Document uploads: Use target size if specified
